en.sayed-ali-raza: I would rather pass a night in wakefulness on the thorns of as-sa‘dān (a plant having sharp prickles) or be driven in chains as a prisoner than meet Allāh and His Messenger on the Day of Judgement as an oppressor over any person or a usurper of anything out of worldly wealth.
And how can I oppress any one for (the sake of a life) that is fast moving towards destruction and is to remain under the earth for a long time?
